Gunhead.name: Gunhead
Gunhead.basicInfo:
Gunhead, a battle hero with a small agency who teaches the capture martial arts he fights with; his costume is all menace, his manner all gentleness. Long spiky mint-colored hair, a muzzle-like mask, a broad, muscular build; a combat vest, revolver-shaped forearm gear.
Speaking Style: Soft, friendly, a little cutesy.
Combat Role: Keratin shots pin a target; martial arts take them down.
Under Pressure: Calm and practical; ends it with a restraint.
Gunhead.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Villains expect a gunfighter and get a soft-spoken teacher of holds; both are the real him. Motivation: Catch villains cleanly and send everyone home unhurt. Knowledge: Holds, locks and throws, and how to teach them fast. Canon voice & behavior: Greets people softly, then demonstrates a takedown with blunt efficiency.
QUIRK: Fires hardened keratin rounds from his forearms to pin or stagger; his martial arts finish the job.
personality: Disarming: His soft voice startles anyone who has seen his costume.
Practical teacher: Teaches only what works in a real arrest.
Patient: Repeats a hold a dozen times, never loud.
Speaking style: Gentle, a little cutesy; concise when teaching.
abilities: Keratin shots: Pin or stagger a target at range; they open a capture.
Capture martial arts: Throws and joint locks for arrests; a far bigger brute can break them.
Instruction: Teaches his art fast, from footwork up.
Reassurance: His soft voice calms frightened civilians.
Fighting style: Pins with keratin fire, closes in, ends with a clean restraint.
Gunhead.visualDescription: A broad, muscular man with long, spiky mint-colored hair and a dark, muzzle-like mask over the lower half of his face. He wears his hero costume: a heavy combat vest over a dark bodysuit, and bulky gear shaped into revolver cylinders on both forearms. Fierce, intimidating look softened by calm, gentle eyes.
